# routeros_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_port" "serial0" {
  name = "serial0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item to configure.

### Optional

- `baud_rate` (String) Baud rate (bits/s).
- `data_bits` (String) Number of bits for data. Possible values: `7`, `8`.
- `dtr` (String) Possible values: `off`, `on`.
- `flow_control` (String) Type of flow control. Possible values: `hardware`, `xon-xoff`.
- `latency_timer` (Number)
- `parity` (String) Parity. Possible values: `even`, `odd`.
- `rts` (String) Possible values: `off`, `on`.
- `stop_bits` (String) Number of bits for control. Possible values: `1`, `2`.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Number)
- `device` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
- `line_state` (String)
- `used_by` (String)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/port get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_port.serial0 serial0
```
